credit.name: Florida Qualified Target Industry Tax Refund
credit.summary: Performance-based tax refund for qualified target industries (logistics, transportation, distribution) creating 10+ net new jobs paying at least 115% of the average private-sector wage. Local government must provide a 20% cash match.

thresholds._note: Wage threshold of 115% of average private-sector wage in the county. Logistics and distribution qualify as target industries under F.S. § 288.106(2)(q).

benefit._note: $3,000 per net new job for non-rural areas (Jacksonville, Miami). Rural areas qualify for $6,000/job. Refund is paid over multiple years as job milestones are met.
